patterns.note: Asymmetrical split-screen layout with large, full-bleed product imagery occupying the left side of the viewport, contrasted with expansive whitespace or minimal text content on the right.
Consistent use of a single, light-weight sans-serif typeface for all text elements, including navigation, product titles, and body copy, creating a subtle and understated typographic hierarchy.
Strategic use of a deep reddish-brown as a full-bleed background section to punctuate the otherwise neutral, light-toned palette and act as a visual separator or accent.
Sections of content, primarily large product images or solid color blocks, slide vertically into the viewport from the bottom as the user scrolls, creating a continuous, gallery-like reveal.
Each product or work is presented as a distinct, near full-viewport height section, creating a focused, one-at-a-time browsing experience.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header for global navigation that remains fixed at the top of the viewport.

Content sections are designed as full-height or near full-height panels. As the user scrolls, new content panels (large images or solid color blocks) slide up from the bottom of the viewport, replacing the previous content in a sequential reveal.
Product titles and descriptions on the right side appear to fade in or slide in subtly as their corresponding image section becomes prominent in the left viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely subtle, almost uniform scale with small, light-weight uppercase text for navigation and titles, and slightly larger but still modest body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially on the right side of the split layout, with large areas of whitespace and distinct, well-separated content sections.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its highly minimalist, gallery-like presentation using a split-screen layout with large, full-bleed product images on the left and vast amounts of whitespace on the right. The subtle scroll-triggered vertical reveals of these large image sections, punctuated by bold, full-bleed color blocks, creates a refined and deliberate browsing experience that prioritizes visual impact and product focus over dense information.
